Product Demonstration and Technical Verification in PreBid Meeting The Unit is engaged in the development and fabrication of specialised electronic equipment, as well as the repair, maintenance, and upgradat ion of specialised systems to meet the customised requirements of various technical projects. Accordingly, all items procured through the bid ding process must meet the prescribed technical specifications, functional requirements, quality standards, and compatibility criteria. In view of the specialised nature of these requirements, participation in the Pre-Bid Meeting shall be mandatory for all prospective bidders. Ea ch bidder shall be required to present the relevant product samples, prototypes, or representative units, as applicable, during the Pre-Bid Mee ting for technical evaluation, physical inspection, fitment verification, and assessment of build quality and compatibility with the intended syst em. The Unit shall also conduct functional testing and test runs of the submitted items, wherever applicable, to assess their operational performa nce, reliability, and suitability for the intended application, thereby ensuring their satisfactory performance and usability in future deployment. Only those bidders whose submitted samples successfully meet the prescribed technical, qualitative, fitment, and functional requirements, as determined by the competent technical evaluation authority, shall be considered eligible for further participation in the bidding process, subje ct to the applicable tender conditions. Failure to attend the mandatory Pre-Bid Meeting, present the required samples, or facilitate the prescribed technical evaluation and testing m ay result in disqualification from further consideration in the bidding process, in accordance with the tender terms and applicable procuremen t rules. The supplier shall provide a live demonstration of the drone, equipment, accessories, or spare parts, wherever applicable, before final accepta nce of the product. The demonstration shall verify the product's functionality, performance, specifications, and compatibility with the existing drone system. The purchaser reserves the right to reject any product that fails to meet the agreed specifications or demonstration requireme nts. 2. Product Specifications and Compatibility All supplied items must be brand new, genuine, unused, and as per the approved make, model, part number, and technical specifications me ntioned in the Purchase Order. Drone spare parts, batteries, flight controllers, motors, ESCs, propellers, cameras, sensors, communication mod ules, and other accessories must be compatible with the intended drone model. No substitution shall be permitted without prior written appro val from the purchaser. 3. Installation, Integration and Commissioning

The supplier shall provide installation, fitting, integration, configuration, calibration, and commissioning of the supplied drone items or spare p arts, wherever applicable. Installation shall be carried out by qualified technical personnel in accordance with the manufacturer's guidelines. T he supplied equipment shall be tested to ensure proper functioning before acceptance by the purchaser. Charges for installation and commiss ioning must be clearly specified in the quotation. 4. Testing and Acceptance All items shall be subject to inspection and functional testing by the purchaser. Acceptance shall be subject to satisfactory demonstration, inst allation (where applicable), and verification of the agreed technical requirements. If any item is found defective, incompatible, damaged, or no n-functional, the supplier shall rectify the issue or replace the item at no additional cost, as agreed under the Purchase Order. 5. Warranty and Guarantee The supplier shall provide the applicable manufacturer's warranty and clearly specify the warranty period for each item in the quotation and i nvoice. The warranty shall cover manufacturing defects and failures attributable to defective materials or workmanship, subject to the manuf acturer's warranty terms and applicable law. The supplier shall provide warranty documentation, serial numbers, and proof of purchase where ver applicable. Any exclusions, particularly for batteries, consumables, crash damage, and misuse, must be disclosed in writing before order c onfirmation. 6. After-Sales Service and Technical Support The supplier shall provide after-sales service and technical support for all supplied items during the applicable warranty period and, where agr eed, after expiry of the warranty. Support shall include fault diagnosis, troubleshooting, repair coordination, replacement assistance, and tech nical guidance for installation and operation. The supplier shall provide contact details for its service team and communicate the process for r aising service requests. 7. Repair and Replacement of Defective Items Any item found defective during installation, testing, or the applicable warranty period shall be repaired or replaced in accordance with the ag reed warranty and service terms. The supplier shall communicate the expected resolution time and bear applicable repair, replacement, and t ransportation costs where covered under the warranty or otherwise agreed in the Purchase Order. 8. Delivery of Spare Parts and Accessories The supplier shall deliver all ordered items along with the required accessories, connectors, cables, mounting hardware, manuals, calibration i nformation, and other components specified in the Purchase Order. All supplied parts must be properly packed and protected against damage during transportation.

9. Training and Technical Documentation Where required, the supplier shall provide basic operating instructions, installation guidance, maintenance instructions, troubleshooting docu mentation, and technical training for the purchaser's authorized personnel. Any charges for training or specialized technical support must be agreed upon in advance. .
